text: With m2 fixed, seed 23 at N=128 cut its N=64 force gap from about 0.12 to 0.074 between steps 3000 and 6000 and is still gaining about 0.011 R2 per 1000 steps. Seed 22 cut its gap only from 0.098 to 0.086 and has nearly levelled off. Trained to 12000 steps, does seed 23 come within 0.02 of N=64 while seed 22 stays more than 0.04 below? That would make 'ceiling vs slower convergence' depend on the seed rather than on N.
